system.details:
A ratcheting monocle spilling over with gears and moving parts. Designed to hold several lenses, each one with different properties. Choose two benefits from the following list:

  • Feathered Lens - Gain a distant bird's-eye view of your current location,
  • Rainbow Quartz Lens - Allows the viewer to peer into the spectral realm,
  • Cracked Lens - Look around corners and through small gaps,
  • Sapphirine Lens - See the sky above you, regardless of what's in the way,
  • Warped Lens - See through illusions and deception,
  • Vexing Lens - Gain a third-person view of yourself.
